The '''FC-20 speeder bike''' was a small, one-being [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] produced by [[Razalon/Legends|Razalon]] prior to the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] owned a custom FC-20, dubbed the '''Sith speeder''', though actually named [[Bloodfin/Legends|''Bloodfin'']].

==Characteristics==
[[File:FC-20_frontback.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Front and rear views of an FC-20.]]

The Razalon FC-20 speeder bike consisted of a semi-circular body powered by a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] and piloted with a simple steering handle. The strange, curved body gave the FC-20 a low center of gravity, affording its rider a dramatically improved cornering ability. The FC-20 was most useful for those who did not wish to be seen, since the compact design presented a small target profile. The FC-20 was not armed, though for assassins like Darth Maul, who wielded a deadly [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]], this hardly mattered.

As with many other swoopbikes, the ''FC-20 ''was a small repulsorlift vehicle with a powerful rear thrust engine. Its engine systems were designed to provide the rider with fast acceleration and allowed it to reach maximum open-ground speed within seconds. Its design gave it an extremely low center of gravity, improved its cornering ability greatly and presented enemies with a very small target.

The FC-20 speeder also lacked shields or sensors, though an auto-brake feature brought the bike to a safe halt if the rider released the steering handles. Though popular, the FC-20 model was considered to be slower than other speeder bikes of the time, with a maximum speed of 180 kilometers per hour. The speeder bike also had a limited range before a recharge was required. It had a small repulsorlift engine with heavy baffling which made it a very quiet vehicle. That and its low riding height made it a popular vehicle for use in scouting.

==History==
[[File:SwoopClass_negvv.jpg|thumb|right|180px|The FC-20 speeder bike compared to Swoop Bike types]]
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], while seeking out [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Darth Maul used the ''Bloodfin'' to combat Master [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]. Having jumped from the speeder, it presumably halted due to the auto-brake feature and was used by Maul to return to his starship [[Scimitar/Legends|''Scimitar'']]. Following Maul's presumed death at the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] at the hands of Qui-Gon's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], the ''Bloodfin'' was confiscated by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] authorities along with his [[Scimitar/Legends|starship]] though they both later mysteriously disappeared forever. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], a cloned Darth Maul once again used such a speeder during [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Jabba's demolition games|demolition games]]. It is unknown as to whether it was the ''Bloodfin'' or another of this make.

The [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Garth Ezzar]] owned a speeder bike that resembled to Maul's speeder bike, the ''Bloodfin'', and was kept aboard [[Garth Ezzar's Sith Infiltrator|Ezzar's Sith Infiltrator]]. He used it during the [[Destruction of the Almas Academy]], where he flew it from his landing point in a ravine on [[Almas]] to the [[Almas Academy]].
